title: Pogoda.by v0.1.2
body:
## Release v0.1.2

GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow added, MIT License, and enhanced README organization.

### What's New

- **GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow** — Automated testing on Python 3.11 and 3.12 on every commit and pull request
- **MIT License** — Proper open-source licensing for distribution
- **Enhanced README organization** — Installation and configuration buttons moved to appropriate sections in all 4 languages

### Technical Details

- **CI/CD**: Tests run automatically on every push and PR
- **License**: MIT (see [LICENSE](https://github.com/Toropyga/pogoda_by/blob/master/LICENSE))
- **Python versions tested**: 3.11, 3.12

### Test Results

- All 36 existing tests continue to pass
- GitHub Actions validates syntax and runs full test suite

### Installation

**Marketplace (Home Assistant 2026.11+):**
Settings > Marketplace > Add from link > https://github.com/Toropyga/pogoda_by

**HACS (Earlier versions):**
HACS > Custom repositories > Add https://github.com/Toropyga/pogoda_by as **Integration**

---

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Toropyga/pogoda_by/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) for full details.
